focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of the printed text (verified via OVD + Text Auditor).
Geometric depth and physical grounding of the spools (verified via Depth Auditor).
Topological connectivity of the spool hubs (verified via Topology Auditor).
Mechanical plausibility of the lower strip cutouts.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the cassette. AI models often fail to render readable text, resulting in 'alien script' or gibberish. Use the open_vocabulary_detector to precisely locate these text regions before auditing. Critically evaluate the 3D structure of the spools: use the geometric_depth_auditor to ensure they are recessed inside the casing and not floating. Check the topology of the spool hubs to ensure they are connected to the internal mechanism and not disjoint parts. The lower metallic strip with random holes is highly suspicious of structural hallucination.
image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a green audio cassette tape. The image displays the upper portion of the cassette body with two visible spool hubs inside circular windows. Below the green casing is a metallic or beige strip containing rectangular cutouts. There is text printed on the green plastic and the lower strip, but it appears distorted and illegible.
